title: A Third Trading Challenge ($1000 prize)
author: Fynca
selftext:
Our current simulated challenge is already underway, with traders competing on the live leaderboard. The feedback has been incredibly valuable, so we’re opening another challenge from **September 14–25**.

Entry is completely free, with a **$1,000 prize pool**:

🥇 1st place: $700  
🥈 2nd place: $200  
🥉 3rd place: $100

Everyone starts with the same demo balance and trades US stocks and ETFs. No real money is deposited or traded.

**How are prizes paid?**

We’ve already completed one $1,000 challenge, with two Reddit users among the winners. Rewards are distributed through Tremendous after the results are verified and can be redeemed through options such as digital Visa, Amazon and other gift cards, or PayPal where supported.

**Do you need to reveal your strategy?**

Not at all. Your research, strategy, and reasoning remain private. We only review trading activity and portfolio performance to verify the leaderboard and ensure fair play.

Fynca brings financial data, news, TradingView charts, and AI into one research canvas, allowing traders to research ideas and test their decisions using simulated capital.

Registration is now open through our website. You can also comment below, and I’ll send you the details. If you’d like to see how everything works first, I’m happy to give you a personal demo.

Questions and healthy skepticism are always welcome.
